scope: Two old development weeks selected for high observed late-rescue spending in the descriptive screen. This is an enriched mechanism screen, not unbiased generalization evidence.
hypothesis: After the public last-pickup time passes, reset the price of an unbooked public single-car gig to1.2 times its route-adjusted opening fee, rising to1.45/1.9/2.5 at120/240/360 minutes from that fixed cutoff. Repeated raises and restarts cannot postpone escalation. No shared or booked gig resets.
primary: Whole-week ledger margin; matched identical source/settings except lateRescue flag. Retain every trial and operational error.
safety: Both treatment weeks must qualify and finish with no undelivered orders. Record refunds, paid fees, late counts and activation traces; a cheaper opening alone is not success.
decision: If both paired margins improve and safety criteria pass, test on a broader old development panel before reserving fresh validation seeds. Never tune this variant mid-study.
